mapper.sql: main.*, COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('sc', s.sc, 'tc', s.tc)) FROM NC.${dialect}_hanzi_similar s WHERE s.hanzi_id = main.id), JSON_ARRAY()) AS similar FROM NC.${dialect}_hanzi main
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE CAST(main.sc AS BINARY) = CAST(#{hanzi} AS BINARY) OR CAST(main.tc AS BINARY) = CAST(#{hanzi} AS BINARY)

SELECT WHERE CAST(main.sc AS BINARY) = CAST(#{hanzi} AS BINARY) OR CAST(main.tc AS BINARY) = CAST(#{hanzi} AS BINARY) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NC.${dialect}_hanzi_similar s WHERE s.hanzi_id = main.id AND (CAST(s.sc AS BINARY) = CAST(#{hanzi} AS BINARY) OR CAST(s.tc AS BINARY) = CAST(#{hanzi} AS BINARY)))
SELECT WHERE CAST(main.${lang} AS BINARY) = CAST(#{hanzi} AS BINARY)
SELECT * FROM NC.${dialect}_hanzi WHERE CAST(sc AS BINARY) = CAST(#{ch.sc} AS BINARY) AND CAST(tc AS BINARY) = CAST(#{ch.tc} AS BINARY)
SELECT id, hanzi_id, sc, tc FROM NC.${dialect}_hanzi_similar WHERE hanzi_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NC.${dialect}_hanzi (sc, tc, pinyin, special, note, status) VALUES (#{ch.sc}, #{ch.tc}, #{ch.pinyin}, #{ch.special}, #{ch.note}, #{ch.status})
INSERT INTO NC.${dialect}_hanzi_similar (hanzi_id, sc, tc) VALUES (#{ch.hanziId}, #{ch.sc}, #{ch.tc})
mapper.update: UPDATE NC.${dialect}_hanzi SET sc=#{ch.sc}, tc=#{ch.tc}, pinyin=#{ch.pinyin}, special=#{ch.special}, note=#{ch.note}, status=#{ch.status} WHERE id=#{ch.id}
UPDATE NC.${dialect}_hanzi_similar SET hanzi_id=#{ch.hanziId}, sc=#{ch.sc}, tc=#{ch.tc} WHERE id=#{ch.id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM NC.${dialect}_hanzi ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1

SELECT id FROM NC.${dialect}_hanzi WHERE (COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(pinyin, '$[0].code')), ''), id) < (SELECT COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(pinyin, '$[0].code')), ''), id FROM NC.${dialect}_hanzi WHERE id=#{id}) ORDER BY COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(pinyin, '$[0].code')), '') DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id FROM NC.${dialect}_hanzi WHERE (COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(pinyin, '$[0].code')), ''), id) > (SELECT COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(pinyin, '$[0].code')), ''), id FROM NC.${dialect}_hanzi WHERE id=#{id}) ORDER BY COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(pinyin, '$[0].code')), ''), id LIMIT 1
